protocol.split: By run seed, before windowing. One run per preset; small illustrative test, not a generalization estimate.
protocol.matching: One-to-one, nearest eligible event; wheel and quality observations excluded from track-event predictions.
protocol.baseline: Raw absolute acceleration > 1 m/s²; 0.65 hysteresis, 0.45 s cooldown.
protocol.classification: Conditional accuracy on matched track events only; misses reported separately.
protocol.negative_count: Not defined for event matching; no true-negative claims.
